# NPM Improved 1.5.1 — Analytics Center section architecture

Turns Analytics Center into a **real multi-page administrative section** instead of a single cramped tab-based view.

- Dedicated, lazy-loaded URL routes for Overview, Trends, Traffic Breakdown, HTTP Routes, TCP/UDP Streams, Request History, Connection History, IP Addresses, User Agents & Bots, Errors & Security, Blocking & Enforcement and Performance.
- Persistent section navigation with clear Reporting, Investigation and Security groups, plus a responsive layout for narrower viewports.
- Node selection context and time / host / HTTP status filters shared across page navigation.
- Request deep-link filters preserved from IP, user-agent and bot investigation; block-rule preparation links carry the selected IP or agent to Blocking.
- Dedicated sortable-period interval trend view and HTTP connection/request-ID investigation. Clearly identifies request-derived connection observations versus real socket open/close events.
- Preserves the **original per-proxy-host Analytics** route and all existing Nginx enforcement, source IP, user-agent, bot and audit features.
- Regression coverage for every analytics deep link, filtered URL and original host analytics route.
- No new external services, containers or debug overlays.

Node-local analytics remain node-local. This release reorganizes the interface without fabricating TCP sessions or replicating telemetry through NPMX.
